purpose: Discover rational linear transformation without a predefined candidate dictionary
observed_content: Three sealed 7x7 rational systems recovered from seven linearly independent mixed input/output probes using exact Gauss-Jordan reconstruction. Left/right fixed subspace dimensions, mass conservation, rotational equivariance and invertibility identified from recovered matrix; twenty unseen states and four two-step states per system predicted exactly.

retrieval_log.surface: Executed Python standard-library exact Fraction test
retrieval_log.result: 90 checks passed; 3/3 recovered; 60/60 held-out and 12/12 two-step predictions correct.

negative_control: Only six standard basis probes cannot distinguish A from A+5e0e6^T. Rank-deficient seven-probe list rejected.
claims: Dictionary-free linear operator identification succeeds for full-rank exact probes within linear hypothesis class
Data underdetermines an arbitrary linear map when probe span is insufficient
limitations: Operator linearity and dimension 7 supplied in advance; does not infer arbitrary nonlinear equations or prove novelty
Simulated deterministic data generated from assistant-chosen systems; no truly independent blinded benchmark
No direct RH/Navier–Stokes proof or ancestry evidence
